title: Revenue Mobilisation Performance, Compliance and Accountability
summary_plain: Strengthening revenue collection through improved tax administration, enhanced compliance strategies and robust enforcement. Widening the tax base, minimising revenue leakages and promoting voluntary compliance, while ensuring transparency, accountability and integrity in all revenue processes.

title: Digital and Data Capability Transformation
summary_plain: Modernising systems through digital transformation and the strategic use of data: investing in advanced ICT infrastructure, automating core processes and leveraging data analytics to support evidence-based decisions, better service delivery and compliance monitoring.

title: Stakeholder Engagement and Partnerships
summary_plain: Building trust and strong relationships with taxpayers, government institutions, development partners and other stakeholders through taxpayer education, better communication channels and stronger partnerships for a collaborative approach to revenue mobilisation.

title: Workforce Capability, Accountability and Productivity
summary_plain: Developing a competent, ethical and high-performing workforce through recruitment, continuous learning, performance management, and a culture of accountability, integrity and productivity — including ethics/anti-corruption and staff health.

title: Operational Efficiency and Trade Facilitation
summary_plain: Streamlining internal processes and enhancing service efficiency to reduce the cost and time of doing business: simplifying procedures, eliminating bottlenecks and implementing trade facilitation measures while maintaining effective regulatory controls.
